# Transport Score

Transport Score is a public tool by Fusion Party Australia that scores every Melbourne suburb's public transport quality from 0 to 100, based on frequency, coverage, and reliability from the PTV GTFS timetable data.

## What it does

- Scores every public transport stop in metropolitan Melbourne using the official PTV GTFS feed published on Data Vic
- Aggregates stop scores to suburb level using a weighted average
- Ranks all Melbourne suburbs in a public league table
- Proposes a costed bus network plan to fix the worst-served areas

## Score methodology

- Score range: 0–100
- Data source: PTV GTFS timetable feed (discover.data.vic.gov.au/dataset/gtfs-schedule)
- Scoring dimensions: Frequency 50%, Coverage 50%
- Score bands: 0–20 Stranded, 20–40 Struggling, 40–60 Adequate, 60–80 Connected, 80–100 Excellent
- Coverage area: Metropolitan Melbourne, Victoria, Australia

## Key pages

- / — Suburb lookup: enter any Melbourne suburb to get its score
- /suburbs — Full league table of all Melbourne suburbs ranked by transport score
- /methodology — Complete scoring methodology (data source, weights, thresholds, formulas)
- /the-plan — Fusion Party's costed feeder bus network improvement plan
- /map — Map explorer showing every scored stop across Melbourne
- /score/[suburb-slug] — Individual suburb score page (e.g. /score/werribee)

## About

Built by Fusion Party Australia for the November 2026 Victorian state election.
Data: PTV GTFS timetable feed published on Data Vic (data.vic.gov.au)
Contact: contact@fusionparty.org.au
Authorised by K. Hunt, FUSION, Mansfield VIC
